uniform_influence : ∀ (r : ℕ),
  3 ≤ r →
    ∃ C,
      0 < C ∧
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          r ≤ n →
            ∀ (p : ℝ),
              0 < p →
                p < 1 →
                  ∀ (f : Config n r → Bool),
                    IsInvariant f → variance p f ≤ C * totalInfluence p f / Real.log ↑n ^ (↑r / (↑r - 1))
